name: manual_31a524
claim: skill-absorption-map 'FAILURE' label means unabsorbed skill clusters were found — it is a diagnostic output, NOT a system error. The map identifies skills that should be consolidated into parent harnesses. Treat FAILURE candidates as architecture TODOs: they specify which child skills should be absorbed into which harness (e.g. hermes-harness absorbs hermes-agent + pt-orama-harness-integration; perpetua-hardware absorbs local-inference). Act on them as refactoring targets, not bug reports.

decisions.notes: Clarified while graduating bb70a6833f36 (2026-07-04). User confirmed the FAILURE label was causing the candidate to look like a crash report when it is actually an architecture gap report from Hermes self-assessment.
